fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League Military has long fielded some of the largest infantry formations in the Inner Sphere, with regiments numbering nearly 1,800 soldiers compared to roughly 750 in the Combine and just over 1,000 in the Federated Suns. Tracked mechanized platoons sacrifice road speed for all-terrain capability, carrying their infantry across ground that would halt wheeled vehicles. The FWLM assigns these formations to worlds where rough terrain or poor infrastructure demands mobility that wheels cannot provide. Trained as military sappers, these troops specialize in obstacle construction, demolition, and field fortification, combining engineering and combat skills to shape the battlefield before and during engagements.
